scope: Native Nav2 1.1.20 AStarAlgorithm<NodeLattice> + GridCollisionChecker on frozen global costmaps. No simulator/controller/localization started.
comparison: Identical recorded planner starts/goals, 5cm map, footprint/padding0, planner parameters, native binary and host; only primitive JSON changes. Minimum-turning-radius heuristic follows each primitive metadata. No path smoothing.
collision_threshold: Native checker possible-inscribed-cost derived from shared footprint and inflation scale 6; 72 orientation bins.
timing: Single cold-process search per combination; exploratory only, not repeatable timing benchmark.
